einzeiler: Bestselling author Emma Brodie discusses her unique creative process and hit novel.
kurzfassung: Author Emma Brodie joins the podcast to discuss her hit novel Into the Blue and her writing journey. She shares insights into combining unexpected genres like sci-fi and improv with romance. The conversation also covers her writing habits, research rabbit holes, and upcoming projects.
stichpunkte: Emma Brodie shares her preference for late-night writing and books that make her cry.
She discusses the challenges and joys of writing her debut book Ursa Major compared to Into the Blue.
Into the Blue blends romance with sci-fi elements and reality television tropes.
Brodie explains how she navigated structural edits and changed her publishing team to keep her vision intact.
Her unique soundtrack for Into the Blue ranges from Radiohead and Eminem to Tchaikovsky.
She details quirky research methods, including falling down Wikipedia rabbit holes about the mob.
Brodie reveals her character inspirations, such as spotting a stranger at a Patti Smith concert for AJ.
She shares her current reading list and upcoming travel plans to the UK.

kapitel.titel: Discussing Her Books and Writing Style
The Inspiration Behind Into the Blue

clips.hook: Writing late at night in an empty house
clips.text: The author shares her preference for working during quiet nocturnal hours while her household sleeps to avoid missing out on social activities.

clips.hook: Describing Into the Blue in two words
clips.text: The conversation shifts to discussing the emotional appeal of fiction featuring intense romance combined with melancholy.

clips.hook: Cutting a massive manuscript down to size
clips.text: She explains why she replaced her literary agent and editors to align with her creative vision and shortened her manuscript accordingly.

clips.hook: Listening to compilation albums on repeat
clips.text: Musical nostalgia comes up as they compare pop albums from their youth and trade memories about Ashlee Simpson.

clips.hook: An Amazon hammock and a confused dog
clips.text: Casual beach habits are discussed, including why crackers are the ultimate snack on the sand and managing portion control.

beschreibung:
Today, the gals are sitting down with the one, the only, Emma Brodie! The New York Times bestselling author of Into the Blue is pulling back the curtain on the story that captured readers’ hearts and giving all the behind-the-book details they've been dying to know.
Emma takes listeners behind the scenes of how this beautifully creative, story came to life, the songs and shows that inspired her while writing it, the characters and moments that surprised her along the way, and what it’s really like to watch a book go from a spark of an idea to a New York Times bestseller. Plus, she spills on what’s next, what she’s reading, and all the little details that make her creative world so uniquely hers.
It's an interview you don't want to miss!
